gen-gf-sniglet-gf-scope-one: Scope One brings a classic serif with generous openings and stubby ascenders under a tall x-height, set below Sniglet's quiet, level heading. Size it up a touch.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-slabo-13px: Rounded and marker-like, Sniglet draws every line at a constant width up top. Slabo 13px replies with a dignified text serif whose counters stay wide, so give it a little more size.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-suwannaphum: Blunt and friendly, Sniglet keeps its arms and legs at a constant width. Suwannaphum is the serif that carries the weight of editorial text, with its high x-height doing the work the heading never tries to.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded: Authoritative describes BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif whose thin joins are as stout as its stems, slowing the pace under Snowburst One's stencil cuts. Stout strokes link the two.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab holds the body with a stretched-out look and open counters, and no hairline anywhere against a thick stem. Snowburst One is the one for tall, stencil-cut statements; Hepta Slab is the one for settling into a paragraph.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-kiwi-maru: Expressive is the word for Snowburst One, with its tall lowercase and wide stencil bridges up top. Kiwi Maru is the traditional text serif for steady reading, giving generous letterspace and rounded o shapes with a constant wall.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-padyakke-expande: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, each c opening like a pitcher's mouth, beneath Snowburst One's tall stencil. A tall heading, a wide body: both sit loose.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-stint-ultra-expa: Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart, with a bent-cable feel and no swelling or thinning anywhere. Snowburst One is best at loud, tall stencil headings; Stint Ultra Expanded is best at spacious, traditional text.
gen-gf-sofadi-one-fs-rowan: Sofadi One leaves its letter mouths open like an unjoined chalk arc, with sturdy hairlines to match. And Rowan, a friendly serif with generous curves, makes the literary partner for it.
gen-gf-sofia-fs-amulya: Amulya is a modern sans-serif whose curves stay generously open, set under Sofia's hand-drawn, single-stroke heading. Amulya keeps a long passage moving easily, with a relaxed, contemporary feel from line to line.
